answer: A sybil farm can mint endless names, but its trust graph betrays it: every clone traces back through the same few funders and friends. Require each identity to show three node-disjoint trust paths from long-established seeds, with no shared funder on any path. Honest users ripple outward through unrelated communities; a farm's paths collapse at one onyx bottleneck, its min-cut stays at one however many accounts it adds. Inside its nebula it looks dense, from outside it has a single throat, so standing is capped by that cut, not by account count.
